name: ProjectMind for OpenCode (anomalyco / opencode.ai)
description: Universal local-first project intelligence, opencode.json local MCP server, and AGENTS.md rules for OpenCode.

capabilities.restartInstructions: OpenCode hot-reloads opencode.json and AGENTS.md automatically; run `/mcp list` in OpenCode session to verify.
documentedLimitations: OpenCode requires local MCP servers to specify type: "local" with a command string array.

installationInstructions: Run `projectmind plugin install opencode` in your project root.
upgradeInstructions: Run `projectmind plugin update opencode` to refresh configs, skills, and hooks.
removalInstructions: Run `projectmind plugin uninstall opencode` to cleanly remove integration while preserving project knowledge.
